name: High-Frequency Aware Loss
definition: A loss function using only the first block of a pre-trained VGG-19 model (before max-pooling) to preserve high-frequency details while avoiding texture distortion common in deeper perceptual losses.
summary: High-Frequency Aware Loss is a regularization term that preserves high-frequency details in radiance-field optimization by restricting feature extraction to the first block of a pre-trained VGG-19 model before max-pooling.
